title: kubelet is not running
status: unreviewed: first estimates by Claude on 2026-11-08, not yet reviewed by the author

causes.title: The node was never set up (kubeadm init/join not run)
causes.why: kubeadm's packages enable kubelet, which restart-loops until kubeadm writes its config; very common on a fresh install.

causes.title: Swap is on and kubelet refuses it
causes.why: kubelet fails by default when swap is enabled unless failSwapOn is false.

causes.title: The container runtime (containerd) is down or unreachable
causes.why: kubelet needs a CRI socket; a stopped or misconfigured containerd keeps it failing.

causes.title: kubelet and the runtime disagree on the cgroup driver
causes.why: systemd vs cgroupfs mismatch is a classic kubeadm setup error.

causes.title: kubelet's config or certificates are broken or out of date
causes.why: after upgrades or a half-finished reset, config.yaml or the kubeconfig can be invalid.

evidence.title: kubelet cannot find /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml
evidence.why: kubeadm init/join writes this file; it is missing almost only when they never ran (or after kubeadm reset).

evidence.title: KUBELET_KUBEADM_ARGS is unset
evidence.why: kubeadm writes kubeadm-flags.env at init/join; unset means it has not.

evidence.title: kubelet says swap is not supported
evidence.why: kubelet names swap explicitly when that is what stops it.

evidence.title: kubelet cannot reach the container runtime
evidence.why: CRI connection errors point straight at containerd.

evidence.title: kubelet reports a cgroup driver problem
evidence.why: kubelet prints the two drivers when they differ.
